clinical_and_methodological_notes.calibration_statement: Score averages (0.90 * XGBoost + 0.10 * Transformer) are not established as calibrated clinical probabilities. The sequence model was trained with 22:1 balanced class weighting, shifting raw scores above prevalence. Blended values function as decision/screening ranking indices rather than formal Bayesian posterior probabilities.
clinical_and_methodological_notes.no_threshold_selection_commitment: No operational decision thresholds were selected and no claims of clinical superiority are made. All findings remain exploratory validation evidence.
clinical_and_methodological_notes.disentanglement_summary: Pipeline cleaning (removing 293 date_of_birth columns) lowers standalone PR-AUC by -0.0302 (from 0.2909 to 0.2608). Adding waz_trajectory_slope_3v restores +0.0107 of that gap (to 0.2715). Adding the Transformer to Experiment C shifts PR-AUC by -0.0051 (to 0.2663) while raising ROC-AUC to 0.8395 and lowering Brier to 0.0342. All 95% bootstrap confidence intervals for the hybrid lift span zero.
